---
title: "Public Data Intelligence"
toc: false
---

Research pages built only from free, public data for the **United States** and six
**Southeast Asian** economies: Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, the Philippines and
Singapore. Everything here is computed by scheduled jobs before the site is published. There is
no server behind these pages.

## Modules

| Order | Module | Question it answers | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Tech Value](tech-value/index.qmd) | Which CPU or GPU gives the most performance per dollar at US retail today, and which ones beat what their specifications predict? | Live |
| 2 | Macro Monitor | What moved this month in the US and the six Southeast Asian economies, and is the move unusual? | Not started |
| 3 | Trade and Supply Chain | How is US demand shifting across Southeast Asian suppliers, by product? | Not started |
| 4 | Federal Procurement | Where is US federal contract money moving, and who is winning it? | Not started |

Modules are built one at a time, in this order. The next one does not start until the current
one meets its exit criterion, which is written in the
[repository README](https://github.com/liumOazed/public-data-intelligence#readme).

## How to read these pages

- Every table and chart carries its source, the date the data was retrieved, how often it
  updates and what it cannot tell you.
- Every model is shown next to a naive baseline. If the model does not beat the baseline, the
  page says "no signal found".
- A score or a flag here is a research lead. It is not advice.

See [Methodology](methodology.qmd) for how each number is made and
[Failures log](failures.qmd) for what was tried and did not work.
